Subject: Next steps: Private hosting ops call and checklist review for Zenith Health

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Summary of discovery: primary goals are data residency in a VPC, KMS integration for patient data, and a predictable SLA for 99thpct token latency.
- Suggested next meeting: technical ops workshop (60–75 mins) to walk Zenith infra through our Private deployment architecture, network requirements, and an ops readiness checklist. We want to align on pre-call artifacts and confirm who from your infra team should join (we recommend your network lead + security owner).

Proposed windows (I checked our team's availability):
- Fri 2026-09-04, 08:30–09:45 PT
- Mon 2026-09-07, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Tue 2026-09-08, 14:00–15:15 PT

I attached a short precall checklist and a simple network boundary diagram to help your team prepare (attachment stubs below). Can you confirm which slot works and who from Zenith will join? Also let me know any high-priority questions you want us to cover so we can bring the right SRE/SE.

Attachments: zenith_privhost_precall_checklist.pdf (1 page checklist), network_boundary_diagram.png (diagram)

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
